seen.excerpt: MESURÉ le 08/08/2026 sur 272 articles Europe PMC accès libre 2023-2026 (internal corpus of 272 JATS articles) : présent dans 38 articles (13 %), dont 23 sur 34 du lot physique/maths. Formes réelles, lecture naïve contre lecture assemblée : bio-PMC13252842 → 274 octets, « M H F N » au lieu de « MHFN » ; essai-PMC13263161 → « V ˙ » au lieu de « V˙ » ; essai-PMC13238360 → 1 032 octets, « PV t = PV bl × 1 + Hct bl Hct t − » au lieu de « PVt=PVbl×1+HctblHctt−11−Hctbl » — et la version naïve est en plus TRONQUÉE.
seen.excerpt_en: MEASURED on 2026-08-08 on 272 open-access Europe PMC articles 2023-2026 (internal corpus): present in 38 articles (13 %), of which 23 of the 34 in the physics/maths batch. Real forms, naive reading versus assembled reading: bio-PMC13252842 → 274 bytes, "M H F N" instead of "MHFN"; trial-PMC13263161 → "V ˙" instead of "V˙"; trial-PMC13238360 → 1,032 bytes, "PV t = PV bl × 1 + Hct bl Hct t −" instead of "PVt=PVbl×1+HctblHctt−11−Hctbl" — and the naive version is moreover TRUNCATED.

measured.source: measured 2026-09-10 by pgrepair (SciPyWeightedILP) on the frozen EUR-Lex truth, three identical runs, journal sha256 in measures/reachability-by-damage-2026-09-10.json. Per damage class, not per form: two forms of the same damage and the same visibility get the same answer.

obstacle.reason: Restoring a gap means ADDING, and a deletion-only repair has no such gesture. Its solution is a set of elements to delete; there is no insertion anywhere in it. No weight and no information change that answer.
obstacle.reason_fr: Réparer un manque veut dire AJOUTER, et une réparation par suppression n'a pas ce geste. Sa solution est un ensemble d'éléments à retirer ; il n'y a d'insertion nulle part. Aucun poids et aucune information n'y changent quoi que ce soit.
obstacle.source: derived from what a deletion-only repair can express, read in the repairer's own code — its solution is a set of elements to delete and carries no insertion — together with the measurement of 2026-09-10. Per damage class, not per form.
